sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Dolk was the master of Vedan fencing style, as well as the former holder of the title "Zelban" before he passed the title to one of his disciples.
- He later trained Laberd, but the latter left his side because of the difference in their point of views.
- According to the lore, a person who mastered Vedan fencing style is known as Zelban. This title is originally passed down from the master to their best disciple, but it was hinted that people from Grand Gaia continued the tradition even after they moved to Elgaia.
- The current known "Zelban" in Elgaia is Lugina.
